facts.business: Chalet Hotels Limited is an Indian hospitality and real estate company that owns and operates hotels and rental properties, with a portfolio of 11 owned hotels, 4 operating rental assets, and 9 projects under development.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on ongoing litigation regarding leasehold rights to land and building at Vashi (Navi Mumbai) purchased from K Raheja Corp Private Limited, pending before Supreme Court with uncertainty regarding penalty imposition.

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk at period end from hotel revenue due to pressure to achieve targets
Ongoing litigation on leasehold rights at Vashi property with uncertainty on penalty
Interest rate risk on variable-rate borrowings (Rs 1,986.77 cr as at March 31, 2026)
Capital-intensive business with high debt levels (adjusted net debt Rs 1,812.09 cr as at March 31, 2026)
facts.related_party_note: Loans to related parties of Rs 424.51 cr as at March 31, 2026 (Rs 252.07 cr as at March 31, 2025). Auditor payment includes other services of Rs 6.02 million in FY2026.
